text:
maya: quick sync on an adaptive admission gateway for model onboarding. want to decide which checks are blocking vs advisory.
ben: short answer: contract-level stuff = blocking (shapes, dtypes, attention-mask). heavy perf benches = advisory or approval-gated.
kai: propose buckets by footprint (tiny/small/medium/large) with default probe sets per bucket. small models run ~fast smoke; large models get longer benches.
sophia: safety probe must be blocking. decode determinism on a tiny golden set should be blocking for full admission.
elena: for cost control, require preflight approval when estimated GPU-minutes > 60. tie into approvals bot.
deploy-bot: estimate for "x-85b-quant" full_microbench = 320 GPU-mins -> approval required.
maya: onboarding emits a machine-readable admit_token with metadata: model_hash, export_cfg, bucket, bench_summary, hw_tags, run_ids, admit_level. runtime uses token tags for routing and can reject stale tokens.
ben: bench artifacts must include hw label (A100/H100), image tag, and provenance checksums. store in registry.
kai: fallback: if heavy bench times out, allow graded admission: experimental canary with qps cap + telemetry. safety or contract failures = fail-closed.
sophia: keep golden inputs per (bucket, domain), synthetic/non-PII. bench reports variance; if variance > threshold, flag for manual review.
elena: rollout playbook: onboard -> canary (1% qps 24h) -> ramp (5/20/100) with rollback on metric breach (p95, error-rate, safety hits, quality delta).
maya: action items: 1) i'll draft config schema for adaptive gateway. 2) ben -> admit_token proto example. 3) sophia -> golden sets. 4) elena -> approval gating with deploy-bot. add anything?
sophia: add shim-detection test; if shim applied but runtime lacks support, reject or require shim_support label.
ben: sample admit_token: {"model":"x-85b","hash":"sha256:...","admit_level":"experimental","benches":[{"name":"latency_smoke","result":"pass","hw":"H100","run":"r42"}]}
maya: great, i'll post RFC by Wed EOD. :thumbsup
